question: Does hiring an agent on your marketplace beat doing the job yourself, and can you prove it?

tasks.task: Earn — fees on a liquidity position
tasks.metric: net return on capital (fees − realized convexity cost − costs), P25–P75
tasks.without_agent: mint once at the same width, never touch it (passive_policy)
tasks.note: baseline: 0 usable replays, assumption A5 requires 20; 60 window(s) were shorter than the 24h policy horizon; agent: 0 usable replays, assumption A5 requires 20; 60 window(s) were shorter than the 24h policy horizon
tasks.verdict: no verdict — baseline: 0 usable replays, assumption A5 requires 20; 60 window(s) were shorter than the 24h policy horizon; agent: 0 usable replays, assumption A5 requires 20; 60 window(s) were shorter than the 24h policy horizon

tasks.task: Protect — avoid being picked off by one-way flow
tasks.metric: net return on capital, P25–P75 (the cost of the withdrawals is charged in full)
tasks.without_agent: the same wide band, held through everything (withdrawal disabled)
tasks.with_agent: Sentinel — withdraw on §3.4 toxicity, re-enter after m_clear
tasks.note: baseline: 0 usable replays, assumption A5 requires 20; 60 window(s) were shorter than the 24h policy horizon; agent: 0 usable replays, assumption A5 requires 20; 60 window(s) were shorter than the 24h policy horizon
tasks.verdict: no verdict — baseline: 0 usable replays, assumption A5 requires 20; 60 window(s) were shorter than the 24h policy horizon; agent: 0 usable replays, assumption A5 requires 20; 60 window(s) were shorter than the 24h policy horizon

tasks.task: Choose — which pool to provide liquidity to
tasks.metric: net return on capital of the same agent on the chosen venue, P25–P75
tasks.without_agent: pick the deepest pool (the obvious heuristic: more TVL is safer)
tasks.with_agent: pick the pool whose flow is not one-way (§3.4 imbalance screen)
tasks.note: baseline: 0 usable replays, assumption A5 requires 20; 60 window(s) were shorter than the 24h policy horizon; agent: 0 usable replays, assumption A5 requires 20; 60 window(s) were shorter than the 24h policy horizon
tasks.verdict: no verdict — baseline: 0 usable replays, assumption A5 requires 20; 60 window(s) were shorter than the 24h policy horizon; agent: 0 usable replays, assumption A5 requires 20; 60 window(s) were shorter than the 24h policy horizon
